battle.name: 北魏分裂
battle.brief: 五三四年十月，高歡在鄴城立元善見為帝，遷都於鄴；十二月宇文泰迎孝武帝元修入關中，旋立元寶炬。北魏就此裂為東魏、西魏，同年即在河上動兵。卡面的羅馬標槍是共和末期舊物，早於此數百年退出戰陣，只能作對照。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 五三四年的北魏已是一具被掏空的軀殼：皇帝虛位，軍權歸於並州與河北的實力派，東西兩套朝廷在同一年的十月與十二月先後成立。東魏方面，高歡以渤海王兼丞相之號坐鎮晉陽，把並州軍府經營成直屬的霸府，親領精騎並督河北諸州軍務；都城在鄴，宮廷的虛名由元善見承擔，史稱孝靜帝，詔書出於高歡之手，司空、司馬、刺史與郡守的任命全由霸府決定。河北州郡的郡兵、鄉兵與流民部眾是東魏的兵源與稅源，糧秣沿永濟渠與漳水轉輸，晉陽是軍械與馬匹的集結地。西魏方面，宇文泰以大丞相掌軍國，於長安奉元寶炬為文帝，改元大統；關中、雍州、涼州與秦州的堡寨戶口是立國根基，漢人關隴豪族與鮮卑、羯、氐將領聯姻結盟，形成八柱國、十二大將的軍事骨架，蘇綽在旁主持屯田、府兵與禮制改革，兵力遠不及東魏，地利卻深得多。北魏舊有的兩支武裝此刻分屬兩邊：一支是河陰之變後隨爾朱氏北遷的河北宿衛，另一支是六鎮之亂中起事而後東遷的邊鎮軍人，東魏承其多數，西魏則容納了部分拓跋部舊人。北方還有柔然控弦於漠北，東魏與西魏都遣使爭結；西魏後來與突厥結盟，聯手壓境柔然。南方則是梁朝，蕭衍趁北魏內亂出兵河南，卻在鍾離、壽陽一帶失利，雙方都未能趁勢統一北方。
countriesEn: The Northern Wei of 534 was a hollow shell: the throne was empty of real power, command had passed to the strong men of Bingzhou and of Hebei, and two rival courts were set up within the same year, in October and in December. On the Eastern Wei side Gao Huan, holding the title Prince of Bohai together with that of chancellor, sat at Jinyang and turned the Bingzhou military office into a private base of power known as the bafu, commanding the elite horse in person and supervising the military affairs of the Hebei prefectures. The capital was Ye, the empty throne was filled by Yuan Shanjian, historiographically Prince Xiaojing, and the edicts went out in Gao Huan's hand: the appointment of the ministers of works and of war, of the prefects and of the commandery governors was decided in the bafu. The county levies, the village levies and the refugee populations of the Hebei prefectures were the manpower and the tax base of the Eastern Wei; grain moved by the Yongji canal and the Zhang river, and Jinyang was the muster point for arms and horses. On the Western Wei side Yuwen Tai held the state as chancellor, received Yuan Baoju at Chang'an as Emperor Wen, and changed the era to Datong; the fortified villages and the registered households of Guanzhong, Yongzhou, Liangzhou and Qinzhou were the foundation of the state, and Han great families of Guanzhong bound to Xianbei, Jie and Di commanders by marriage and covenant formed a military frame of eight pillar lords and twelve generals, while Su Chuo presided over the land settlement, the fubing and the reform of the rites; their numbers were far smaller than the Eastern Wei's but their ground was far deeper. Two of the old armed forces of the Northern Wei now belonged to the two sides: one was the Hebei palace guard that had moved north with the Erzhu clan after the disaster on the Yellow River, and the other was the men of the frontier garrisons who had risen in the rebellion of the Six Garrisons and then moved east; the Eastern Wei took most of them, while the Western Wei gave shelter to some of the old Tuoba men. Beyond the north the Rouran held their bowstrings over the steppe, and both Eastern and Western Wei sent envoys to court them; the Western Wei later made a pact with the Turks and pressed on the Rouran together with them. To the south lay the Liang dynasty, whose emperor Xiao Yan moved against Henan during the Northern Wei disorder and failed at Zhongli and Shouyang, so that neither side was able to take advantage of the other's weakness to unite the north.
people: 高歡是這場分裂的樞紐。他出身渤海蓨縣的漢人寒門，早年投身軍旅，爾朱榮帳下為將；鎮兵起事之後，他以鎮將身分聚眾自保，逐步在晉陽握有並州的人、馬、甲兵。爾朱榮被族弟爾朱兆等刺殺於晉陽，高歡懼遭清算，遂於興和初年夜離晉陽，經冀州抵鄴，旬月之間聚眾二十萬，據河北以討爾朱氏；韓陵山一戰破爾朱氏聯軍，賀拔岳出亡被追斬，河北州郡相繼歸順。他先立元善見為帝、遷都鄴以立名分，再以「河橋之約」逼走孝武帝元修：五三四年十月高歡率大軍至洛陽，於黃河橋上與元修立誓，元修遣官屬詣晉陽，高歡疑其行刺，元修乃斬使西奔關中。高歡終身不居帝位，死於五四七年玉璧軍中；子高澄、高洋承之，五五〇年高洋受魏禪改元齊朝。宇文泰是另一端的樞紐：武川鎮出身，與賀拔岳、獨孤信等西遷關中，五三二年排擠賀拔岳而自攬大權，五三四年十二月迎元修入長安，未幾毒殺之，五三五年立元寶炬為帝，自為大丞相秉政，與蘇綽推行府兵、屯田與《周禮》式禮制，最終以府兵與關隴集團奠定北周乃至隋唐的基業。西魏將領中獨孤信、李虎、李弼、于謹、趙貴、侯莫陳崇、萬俟洛並列八柱國，蘇綽掌尚書右僕射；東魏則有段韶、彭樂、斛律金與其子斛律光，高敖曹曾於虎牢關大破獨孤信，被俘後賴侯景說項得脫。柔然可汗與梁武帝蕭衍同為北方的變數：蕭衍趁北魏內亂出兵河南，卻在鍾離、壽陽折挫，這一失手也讓洛陽在數年之後落入高歡之手。
peopleEn: Gao Huan was the pivot of this division. He came from a poor Han family of Tiao county in the province of Bohai, entered the army early, and served as a general in the camp of Erzhu Rong; after the garrison troops rose he gathered men in his own right as a garrison commander, and by degrees took hold of the men, horses and armour of Bingzhou at Jinyang. When Erzhu Rong was killed by his cousin Erzhu Zhao and others at Jinyang, Gao Huan, afraid of being cleared out, left Jinyang by night in the first years of Xinghe, passed through Jizhou to Ye, and gathered twenty thousand men within a few weeks — the histories give twenty thousand in the round — and based himself on Hebei to strike at the Erzhu clan. At Hanling Mountain he broke the Erzhu coalition, Erzhu Baxiong's flight was run down and he was killed, and the Hebei prefectures came over one after another. He first set up Yuan Shanjian as emperor and moved the capital to Ye to give his cause a lawful name, and then forced the flight of Emperor Xiaowu Yuan Xiu by the pact at the river bridge: in October 534 he led his army to Luoyang and swore an oath with Yuan Xiu on the Yellow River bridge, Yuan Xiu sent his officers and ministers to Jinyang, Gao Huan suspected them of plotting his murder, and Yuan Xiu thereupon beheaded the envoys and fled west to Guanzhong. Gao Huan never took the throne himself; he died in camp at Yubi in 547, and his sons Gao Cheng and Gao Yang carried on, Gao Yang receiving the Wei abdication in 550 and founding the Qi dynasty. Yuwen Tai was the pivot on the other side. A native of the Wuchuan garrison, he moved west to Guanzhong with Hebao Yue, Dugu Xin and the rest; in 532 he crowded out Hebao Yue and took the power into his own hands, in December 534 he welcomed Yuan Xiu to Chang'an and poisoned him not long after, and in 535 he set Yuan Baoju on the throne and governed as chancellor, working with Su Chuo on the fubing, the land settlement and the rites after the model of the Rites of Zhou; out of this grew the fubing and the Guanzhong group that were to found the Zhou of the north and, through it, the Sui and the Tang. On the Western Wei side Dugu Xin, Li Hu, Li Bi, Yu Jin, Zhao Gui, Houmochen Chong and Moqi Luo held the eight posts of pillar lord, and Su Chuo was right vice chancellor of the department of state affairs; on the Eastern Wei side were Duan Shao, Peng Yue, Hulü Jin and his son Hulü Guang, and Gao Aochao beat Dugu Xin badly at Hule Pass, and after his own capture it was Hou Jing who obtained his release. The Rouran khan and the Liang emperor Xiao Yan were the other variables of the north: Xiao Yan moved against Henan during the Northern Wei disorder and was checked at Zhongli and Shouyang, and that reverse let Luoyang fall into Gao Huan's hands a few years later.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍是公元前一百年前後共和末期羅馬軍的標準投射兵器，槍身中段掏空、上套鐵箍，捅穿敵盾之後槍桿即折，敵人不能把盾再舉起來，只能拖著半截槍退回掩體。羅馬軍進攻前以縱隊齊射，齊射完即由輕裝步兵衝鋒，殘存的重裝步兵在後接戰，騎兵負責追擊與清剿潰散之敵。這種「讓敵盾失去防護價值」的設計，在五三四年的中原並不存在：羅馬標槍在共和末期之後仍殘留於邊軍，三、四世紀已讓位於較輕的標矛與騎兵長矛，五世紀中葉的東西魏戰場上根本沒有此物。真正可以對照的是北方軍隊手中的槊——河北與河西的漢晉墓葬以及北魏甲騎俑中，騎兵所執多為長身大槊，配合刀、戟、大刀、劍與各式盾牌；步卒以矛、戟與大盾結陣，弓為主要投射武器，弩則有臂弓、蹶張弓與車弩，車弩與投石機是攻城與野戰的火力骨幹。人甲以冪、鎧、介冪為主，配兩當、裲襠與兜鍪，馬亦有馬甲與馬鐙，騎兵在河北正統領主墓中留下披甲執槊的陶俑。攻城器械包括撞車、雲梯、攻城樓、鈎車與木鵰，五四六年高歡造木鵰飛越玉璧城牆即為其例；糧秣靠橐駝、牛車與永濟渠轉運。就設計而言，羅馬標槍與北魏的槊同屬刺穿型長兵器，而中國的長矛桿不設計成折斷；矛折之後反手再刺的例子見於秦楚戰記，說明兩地對待斷兵器的方向不同。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on this card was the standard missile of the Roman army in the closing years of the Republic, around a hundred years before the Christian era. Its middle was hollowed out and sleeved with iron, so that after it had punched through a shield the shaft broke off: the enemy could not raise that shield again and had to drag himself back behind cover with half a weapon still in his hand. The Roman army fired its missiles in files before an assault, the light infantry charged once the volley was done, the heavy infantry that remained took over the fight, and the horse hunted down and destroyed what had broken. That idea of making an enemy's shield worthless was simply not present in the Central Plain of 534: the pilum lingered on in the frontier troops after the Republic, but in the third and fourth centuries it was giving way to lighter javelins and to the lance of the cavalry, and by the middle of the fifth century there was no trace of it on the battlefields of the Eastern and the Western Wei. What can actually be set against it is the shuo, the long heavy spear of the northern armies: in the Han and Jin tombs of Hebei and of Hexi, and in the armoured horsemen figurines of the Northern Wei, the riders carry a long shuo, and they pair it with sabres, halberds, broadswords, swords and shields of every kind. The foot formed up with spear, halberd and large shield, the bow was the chief missile weapon, and the crossbow family included the single-shot arm bow, the drawn crossbow and the waggon crossbow, while the waggon crossbows and the stone-throwers formed the artillery of both siege and field. Body armour was built of the leather apron, the lamellar and the plate, worn with the front and back jacket, the skirt and the helmet, and the horse had its own caparison and saddle; the armoured horsemen of the tombs of the great lords of Hebei survive as potters' figures holding their shuo. The siege train included battering rams, scaling ladders, siege towers, hooked poles and the wooden eagle, of which Gao Huan's attempt to fly one over the wall of Yubi in 546 is the classic case. Grain moved by pack animals, ox carts and the Yongji canal. In design the pilum and the shuo belong to the same family of thrusting weapons, but the Chinese spear shaft was not built to break: the case of a broken spear being turned back in the hand and used again is recorded in the tales of the fighting between Qin and Chu, which shows the two traditions taking broken weapons in different directions.
tactics: 東西魏對峙的基本樣式是河防與據城：東魏倚河北，西魏守關中，中間是洛陽與河中這條南北向的走廊，誰先取洛陽，誰就能把防線推到伊洛河谷。野戰的通例是步兵結陣在前、騎兵在兩翼與後方待機；宇文泰在五三九年守汾州柏壁城時以城垣、壕溝與糧道拖住高歡大軍，相持十餘日而城中不亂，東魏軍中大疫乃退；五三四年河上之役，他背水列陣，趙貴等五將督步兵與齊軍相持不動，待高歡恃眾輕進、陣形鬆散，才以精騎突出敵陣側後，一戰擊潰東魏軍。守城方面，五四六年玉璧之戰韋孝寬以一整套針對性手段應對高歡大軍：撞車逼近即以橫木掛擊，雲梯與木鵰接近即張布幔與繩索遮斷，敵掘地道便在城內掘溝反掘，高歡欲決汾水灌城則築堰堵水，同時城上弓弩與火罐壓制貼城的攻城者。東魏的進攻則填壕、壓迫、覆穴、雲梯與懸梯並用，並配合木鵰飛越城頭，韋孝寬以長杆布幔與火水器具一一抵擋。糧道是雙方共同的弱點：東魏遠征依賴永濟渠與漳水的水運，西魏出關中作戰受制於渭水與關中的儲糧，蘇綽在關中大興屯田，正是為了讓遠征的極限由糧食決定。
tacticsEn: The basic pattern of the Eastern and the Western Wei was river defence and fortified holding: the Eastern Wei leaned on Hebei, the Western Wei on Guanzhong, and between them lay the north-south corridor of Luoyang and the middle Yellow River, so that whoever took Luoyang first could push the line forward into the valleys of the Luo and the Yi. The rule in the field was infantry drawn up in front with the horse waiting on the wings and in the rear. In 539 Yuwen Tai, holding Bai Bi in Fen prefecture, used the wall, the ditch and the supply road to hold off Gao Huan's great army; the fighting went on for more than ten days without the city falling, an epidemic broke out in the Eastern Wei ranks, and the besiegers withdrew. At the fighting on the river in 534 he formed his line with its back to the water, and Zhao Gui with five generals kept the foot in front, refusing to be drawn, waiting until Gao Huan, trusting his numbers, pressed forward and his line loosened; only then did the Western Wei horse strike out on the flank and rear of the enemy and break the Eastern Wei army in a single action. On the defensive side, the battle of Yubi in 546 showed Wei Xiaokuan answering Gao Huan's host with a matched set of counters: the battering ram came close and was caught and broken on a transverse beam; the ladders and the wooden eagle came close and were cut off by sheets and ropes; the enemy dug a tunnel and he had a counter-trench dug inside the wall; when Gao Huan wanted to break the Fen river and flood the city he threw up a weir to hold the water, while the bows, crossbows and fire pots of the wall kept down the men working at the foot of the rampart. The Eastern Wei assault brought filling of the ditch, pressure, filling in of the breached wall, ladders and hanging ladders all together, with the wooden eagle flying over the parapet, and Wei Xiaokuan met each of them with sheets of cloth on long poles and with water and fire. The supply road was the weakness of both: the long marches of the Eastern Wei rested on the water of the Yongji canal and the Zhang river, while the Western Wei campaigns out of Guanzhong were limited by the Wei river and by what the granaries of Guanzhong held, which is exactly why Su Chuo opened up land settlement in Guanzhong: the limit of a long march was to be set by grain.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：五三四年十月高歡立元善見為帝並遷都鄴，十二月孝武帝西奔關中，五三五年元寶炬在長安即位改元大統；五五〇年高洋受禪建北齊，五五七年宇文覺代西魏建北周，五七七年北周滅北齊，五八九年隋滅陳。兵力：據史書，高歡起兵之後旬月之間聚眾二十萬，東魏治下常以步騎十萬、二十萬為概數，五四三年邙山之戰高歡率步騎十萬以上至河上，五四六年攻玉璧的軍隊概數亦為二十萬；西魏以關中、雍、涼、秦數州之地立國，兵制為八柱國、十二大將，柱國之下分領數千之軍，總量遠不及東魏。損失：五三二年韓陵山之戰高歡大破爾朱氏聯軍，五三三年城陽再破爾朱廣；五三八年高敖曹於虎牢關大破西魏獨孤信，西魏方面折損以萬計；五四三年邙山之戰魏軍大勝，斬獲與俘虜齊軍士卒以數萬計；五四六年玉璧攻防相持五十餘日，傳稱東魏攻城士卒死者七萬，高歡病歿軍中，魏軍追擊至汾水。屯田與賦役：蘇綽所立之制，兵百種粟四十畝、兵二十種粟二十畝，歲入約三十石。洛陽官民、府庫與圖籍的東遷是人數與物資都以萬計的大動作。凡涉雙方確切死傷、各部損失比例、邙山與玉璧的具體日期，諸史記載互有出入，只採可以互相印證的量級說法。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. Timing: in October 534 Gao Huan set up Yuan Shanjian as emperor and moved the capital to Ye; in December Emperor Xiaowu fled west to Guanzhong; in 535 Yuan Baoju took the throne at Chang'an and changed the era to Datong; in 550 Gao Yang received the Wei abdication and founded Northern Qi; in 557 Yuwen Jue replaced the Western Wei and founded Northern Zhou; in 577 Northern Zhou destroyed Northern Qi; in 589 the Sui destroyed the Chen. Strength: according to the histories, Gao Huan gathered twenty thousand men within weeks of raising his banner, and the Eastern Wei habitually appears in the sources with a round ten or twenty thousand foot and horse; at the battle of Mangshan in 543 Gao Huan led some ten thousand foot and horse or more to the river, and the host that attacked Yubi in 546 is likewise given in the round as twenty thousand. The Western Wei built its state on the handful of prefectures of Guanzhong, Yong, Liang and Qin, with a military system of eight pillar lords and twelve generals and detachments of several thousand under each pillar lord, so that its total strength was far below the Eastern Wei's. Losses: in 532 Gao Huan broke the Erzhu coalition at Hanling Mountain, and in 533 he broke Erzhu Guang again at Chengyang; in 538 Gao Aochao beat Dugu Xin badly at Hule Pass and the Western Wei lost thousands; in 543 the Western Wei won at Mangshan and took and slew Eastern Wei men by the tens of thousands; in 546 the siege of Yubi went on for more than fifty days, and the Eastern Wei are said to have lost seventy thousand men in the assault, after which Gao Huan died of illness in camp and the Western Wei pursued to the Fen river. Land settlement and service: under the rules drawn up by Su Chuo, a hundred soldiers sowed forty mu of millet and twenty soldiers twenty mu, yielding about thirty sheng a year. The removal of the officials and people of Luoyang, with the stores and the records, to the east was a movement of tens of thousands of persons and a great quantity of goods. For the exact casualties on either side, the losses of each arm, and the precise dates of Mangshan and Yubi the histories differ, and only the order of magnitude that can be cross-checked is given here.
cause: 打起上來的根由有四層。最深的一層是孝文帝以來漢化改革的後果：四九四年遷都洛陽、改姓定門第、通婚姻斷北語，把拓跋舊貴與漢人官僚拉進同一套秩序，六鎮將士卻在邊地逐步失去軍功與出路，鎮兵與鎮民淪為流民，遂有五二三年起的六鎮之亂。其次是政變的破壞：五二八年爾朱榮在洛陽河陰屠殺朝廷，盡誅胡氏、幼主與朝臣二千餘人，扶立元子攸；五三〇年爾朱榮被族弟刺殺於晉陽，爾朱氏以軍閥的資格連立幼主、驅遷都邑，把北魏變成河北軍閥的私產。第三層是並州與河北兩處軍力中心的對立：高歡憑晉陽的地利與鎮兵餘眾起兵，先取河北名分，再圖河南，與西魏的關隴集團勢不兩立；爾朱氏敗亡後，高歡的下一個目標就是洛陽。第四層是北方與南方的地緣擠壓：柔然控弦漠北，東魏與西魏都遣使爭結，西魏後來聯結突厥；南面的梁朝趁北魏內亂揮軍河南，卻在鍾離、壽陽折挫，未能分得一杯羹。於是本已被掏空的北魏，在五三四年同時裂成兩個武裝對峙的政權，而不是像漢末那樣形成一個可供天下歸心的新朝代名號；皇帝仍然存在，國號仍然不改，但下令的人與握槍的人已經分屬兩個營壘。
causeEn: There are four layers to the cause. The deepest is the consequence of the Sinicising reforms begun under Emperor Xiaowen: the move of the capital to Luoyang in 494, the change of surnames and the fixing of ranks, the marriage ties and the abandonment of the northern speech drew the old Xianbei nobles and the Han officials into a single order, while the soldiers of the Six Garrisons on the frontier lost their military honour and their livelihood by degrees, and the garrison men and their families sank into vagrancy, which produced the rising of the Six Garrisons from 523 onward. Next comes the damage done by the coup: in 528 Erzhu Rong drowned the court at Heyin below Luoyang, putting the Empress Dowager Hu, the child emperor and more than two thousand of the court's officers to death, and set up Yuan Ziyou in his place; in 530 Erzhu Rong was killed by his kinsmen at Jinyang, and the Erzhu house, with the rank of a military faction, enthroned one child emperor after another and shifted the capital about, turning the Northern Wei into the private property of a Hebei warlord. Third comes the opposition of two centres of military strength, Bingzhou and Hebei: Gao Huan rose on the strength of the ground at Jinyang and of the leftover garrison men, took the name of Hebei first and then reached for Henan, and he could not stand the sight of the Guanzhong group of the Western Wei; once the Erzhu house was beaten, Luoyang became his next objective. Fourth comes the pressure from the north and the south: the Rouran held their bowstrings over the steppe and both the Eastern and the Western Wei sent envoys to court them, the Western Wei later joining with the Turks, while the Liang dynasty in the south marched into Henan during the disorder and was checked at Zhongli and Shouyang, taking no share of the spoils. So the hollowed-out Northern Wei, in 534, split at one stroke into two armed and mutually opposed states, instead of producing, as at the end of the Han, a new dynastic name to which the world could rally: the emperor still sat on his throne and the state name still did not change, but the man who gave the orders and the man who held the spear now belonged to two different camps.
impact: 分裂結束了北魏，卻開啟了另一條長線：以北齊、北周為主的東西並立延續了四十餘年，直到五七七年北周滅北齊、五八九年隋滅陳才歸於一統，而這條線上的制度大半是在西魏奠基的。蘇綽所立屯田制解決了關中糧食問題，成為隋唐均田制的先聲；他整理的《周禮》式禮制、府兵制與軍政編制，經北周、隋而至唐，成為唐代府兵與禮制的底本。關隴豪族以婚姻與軍功結成的集團，經宇文氏、楊氏、李氏幾代入主中央，唐代皇室的關隴血統由此而來；而北魏孝文帝一代的鮮卑漢化、東西魏之間的通婚與雜居，也在此後數百年間把北族融進漢語世界的秩序裡，隋唐的官僚與將門多能追溯到關中的軍功家族。北方的佛教亦因動盪而變局：太延年間的滅佛之後，釋教在北魏末年大盛，洛陽的伽藍與雲岡、龍門的石窟在分裂前後臻於極盛，而戰亂與侯景之亂又使僧眾與經藏南移，南朝成為新的佛教中心，經論譯業自此偏重江左。軍事技術上，五三〇至五四〇年代密集出現的攻城器械與防禦手段——撞車、雲梯、攻城樓、木鵰、地道、決水與反掘——被後世兵書整理吸收，攻防器械的技術競賽在南北朝末期達到頂點。回頭看卡面那件羅馬標槍，它提醒的是另一件事：單件兵器的壽命遠短於政權的壽命，共和末年的投槍在幾百年內就從歐陸軍中退場，而北魏分裂留下的制度與族群組合，卻一路延伸到唐代。
impactEn: The division ended the Northern Wei but opened a much longer line: the Eastern and Western states built on Northern Qi and Northern Zhou kept each other at bay for more than forty years, and only with the destruction of Northern Qi by Northern Zhou in 577 and of the Chen by the Sui in 589 did the north come back into one piece — and most of the institutions along that line were founded in the Western Wei. The land settlement drawn up by Su Chuo solved the grain problem of Guanzhong and was the forerunner of the equal-field system of the Sui and the Tang; the rites after the model of the Rites of Zhou, the fubing and the military administrative structure that he put in order passed through Northern Zhou and the Sui into the Tang and became the base of the Tang fubing and of Tang ceremonial. The Guanzhong great families, knit together by marriage and by military merit, entered the centre of government in the persons of the Yuwen, the Yang and the Li, and the Tang imperial house drew its Guanzhong blood from them; and the Sinicisation of the Xianbei begun under Xiaowen, with the intermarriage and the mixed residence of the two sides in the years of the split, folded the northern peoples into the order of the Chinese-speaking world over the following centuries, so that most Tang officials and military houses can be traced back to the service families of Guanzhong. The Buddhism of the north was reshaped by the disorder as well: after the suppression of the faith in the Taiyan years it flourished again at the end of the Northern Wei, the monasteries of Luoyang and the cave temples of Yungang and Longmen reached their height around the time of the split, and the wars and the rebellion of Hou Jing then carried monks and sutras south, making the southern courts the new centre of Buddhism and turning the translation of treatises toward the Jiangnan. On the technical side, the siege instruments and defensive devices that crowded the decades from 530 to 540 — the battering ram, the ladder, the siege tower, the wooden eagle, the tunnel, the breach of a river and the counter-mine — were taken up and absorbed by the military writers of later ages, and the competition in offensive and defensive machinery reached its height at the end of the Southern and Northern Dynasties. Looking back at the Roman pilum on this card, it points to a different lesson: the life of a single weapon is far shorter than the life of a regime. The throwing spear of the closing Republic had left the armies of Europe within a few centuries, while the institutions and the mixture of peoples left behind by the division of the Northern Wei ran on into the Tang.
result: 結果是北魏名號終結，東西兩魏並立。五三四年十月高歡立元善見為帝、遷都鄴，十二月孝武帝元修西奔關中，宇文泰毒殺元修，五三五年元寶炬即位於長安、改元大統；北魏的正統從此一分為二，東魏的疆域是河北與部分河南，西魏只保關中與河西數州，面積不及東魏的一半。接下來四十餘年是反覆的拉鋸：五三八年東魏高敖曹於虎牢關大破西魏獨孤信，五四三年西魏在邙山一戰大勝，五四六至五四七年韋孝寬守玉璧擋住高歡大軍並迫其病歿軍中。雙方都未能吃掉對方，於是各自完成蛻變：五五〇年高洋受禪建北齊，五五四年西魏尉遲迥平成都、乘侯景之亂取蜀地，五五五年蕭詧在長安稱帝建後梁，五五七年宇文覺代西魏建北周，五七七年北周滅北齊，五八九年隋滅陳，北方才回到一統。對這場分裂可以下的定論是：北魏亡於將帥與軍鎮對皇室的絕對控制，而不是亡於某一場戰役；卡面的羅馬標槍與五三四年的洛陽、鄴城、長安沒有任何關係，當時真正決定勝負的是騎兵、弩與投石機的射程，是糧道與屯田，是城牆、壕溝與守將的膽量。
resultEn: The result was the end of the Northern Wei and the setting up of two states side by side. In October 534 Gao Huan set up Yuan Shanjian as emperor and moved the capital to Ye; in December Emperor Xiaowu Yuan Xiu fled west to Guanzhong and Yuwen Tai poisoned him; in 535 Yuan Baoju took the throne at Chang'an and changed the era to Datong. The legitimate line of the Northern Wei was from that moment in two, the Eastern Wei holding Hebei and part of Henan, the Western Wei keeping only Guanzhong and a few prefectures of Hexi, less than half the size of its rival. The next forty years were a repeated tug of war: in 538 Gao Aochao beat Dugu Xin badly at Hule Pass for the Eastern Wei, in 543 the Western Wei won handsomely at Mangshan, and in 546 and 547 Wei Xiaokuan held Yubi against Gao Huan's host until the latter died of illness in camp. Neither side could swallow the other, so each completed its own transformation: in 550 Gao Yang received the abdication and founded Northern Qi, in 554 the Western Wei sent Yuwen Jiong to take Chengdu and seize Shu in the confusion of Hou Jing's rebellion, in 555 Xiao Chan set up the Later Liang at Chang'an, in 557 Yuwen Jue replaced the Western Wei and founded Northern Zhou, in 577 Northern Zhou destroyed Northern Qi, and in 589 the Sui destroyed the Chen, so that the north was one again. The verdict on this division is this: the Northern Wei fell to the absolute control of the commanders and the garrison towns over the throne, not to any single battle; and the Roman pilum on this card has nothing whatever to do with Luoyang, with Ye or with Chang'an in 534. What decided those fights was the reach of the horse, of the crossbow and of the stone-thrower, the length of the supply road and the grain dug out of the fields, the height of the wall, the width of the ditch and the steadiness of the men who held them.
